svg.title: AV-07 · The Engagement Roadmap · STATIC SVG sibling · brand-v2 · author-v1 · 2026-05-17
svg.desc: Standalone SVG snapshot of the BOSS engagement roadmap · Bundled view · 8 lanes (PMO orchestration + 7 BOSS delivery stages: Design · Build · Deploy and Test · UAT · Mock Golive · Golive · Stable state/CI-CD) · dual-portfolio density curves (Transformation Portfolio charcoal · Production Agentics Portfolio gold) over a 24-month example engagement window · 14-day sprint hashes along the bottom axis · gold go-live marker at month 20 · CI/CD-by-design loop band below axis encoding stable-state-opens-next-build-plan. Sibling to engagement-roadmap.html (canonical/gated · click-to-expand substance) and engagement-roadmap-public.html (public-tier HTML variant). Static SVG is the most universal sibling — embeddable in articles, decks, PDFs, prospect collateral with zero runtime dependencies. IP-gating clean: density curves surface gradient existence + relative weight only (not calibration math). Author-v1 baked 2026-05-17 from canonical engagement-roadmap.html v2.4.6 config via deterministic Python emit.
svg.text: 8-lane delivery substrate · dual-portfolio density · 24-month engagement · CI/CD-by-design loop
stable state opens next build plan (operator-led) · the engagement doesn't end at go-live
Framework holds across portfolios · density redistributes under agentics · the engagement doesn't end at go-live.
